guard: gate-inventory roots are what CI actually runs, including a suite list a workflow runs through the shard runner, and a suite dropped from that chain is named as ungated
why: Treating `check` as a root made every suite reachable only from that developer chain look gated.
The inventory then printed OK whether CI ran those suites or not. Removing `check` from ROOTS is the
instrument repair; putting join-external:live on its own live-job step is the coverage repair.
Dropping that newly added live invocation must redden the inventory on that suite name.
The find is the dedicated live-job step, not a comment and not a call signature.

mutations.name: drop join-external:live from the live job so a check-only suite looks gated again
mutations.find:
- name: Join an external broker
        run: pnpm smoke:join-external:live

mutations.name: drop the platforms job's list so a suite only it runs looks gated again
the inventory stops reading the lists a workflow runs
mutations.find: for (const { suites } of workflowLists) for (const s of suites) if (s in pkg.scripts) roots.add(s);
